statements.t: Looking ahead, Plug remains focused on sustaining progress across all three objectives in the fourth quarter and going forward, with an emphasis on disciplined cash management, minimizing capital expenditures, and strengthening its operating performance.

risks.t: whether the Company is able to sustain recent reductions in cash burn
the Company's ability to manage working capital, operating expenses, and capital expenditures
whether anticipated customer demand, project activity, bookings, and commercial opportunities materialize as expected
whether awarded projects and opportunities successfully progress to implementation, revenue generation, and commercial operation
the Company's ability to manufacture, deliver, deploy, and service its products in accordance with customer requirements and anticipated schedules
the availability and price of hydrogen, electricity, natural gas, and other key inputs
the pace of market adoption of hydrogen technologies
changes in government policies, regulations, incentives, and funding programs
supply chain disruptions, inflationary pressures, labor availability, and project execution risks
risks related to the Company's future capital requirements and liquidity needs
the Company's ability to obtain financing when needed and on acceptable terms
the timing of revenue recognition, customer acceptance, and contract modifications
customer concentration and counterparty credit risk
delays or cancellations of customer projects, including as a result of customers' failure to reach final investment decisions or secure financing or permits
the performance, commissioning, and acceptance of the Company's products and projects
general market, economic, competitive, geopolitical, and regulatory conditions
